title: Selection of neuroendocrine markers in diagnostic workup of neuroendocrine neoplasms: The real-world data and machine learning model algorithms.
authors: Tang, Haiming; Xia, Haoran; Sun, Nanfei; Hernandez, Patricia V; Wang, Minhua; Adeniran, Adebowale J; Cai, Guoping
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用机器学习算法优化神经内分泌肿瘤诊断标志物组合，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Accurate diagnosis of neuroendocrine neoplasms (NENs) is challenging, especially in poorly differentiated neuroendocrine carcinomas (NECs). This study was aimed to search the best or best combination of neuroendocrine markers in the diagnostic workup of NENs via analysis of the real-world data and machine learning algorithms. METHODS: Cytology cases with a workup of four neuroendocrine markers (chromogranin, synaptophysin, CD56, and INSM1) were retrieved. Sensitivity, specificity, and area under the curve of receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC) were calculated for each marker alone or in combination. Two machine learning algorithms, neural network and random forests, were also tested. RESULTS: The study cohort included 106 NENs (64 NECs and 42 well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumors [NETs]) and 36 non-NEN cases. The combination of synaptophysin and INSM1 had sensitivity of 0.95, specificity of 0.92, and AUC-ROC of 0.93. Addition of CD56 to the combination further increased the sensitivity and AUC-ROC to 1 and 0.96, respectively, in all NENs as well as NEC cases. In addition, the combination of chromogranin, synaptophysin and INSM1 had sensitivity of 1, specificity of 0.92, and AUC-ROC of 0.96 in NETs. Machine learning models, specifically random forests and neural network, confirmed the efficacy of combining synaptophysin, INSM1, and CD56. CONCLUSIONS: The combination of synaptophysin, INSM1, and CD56 has the best performance in diagnostic workup of all NENs, although chromogranin may be selected for NETS. The random forests and neural network models support the common practice rule of requiring at least two out of three markers to be positive for optimal marker utilization.
abstract_zh: 背景：神经内分泌肿瘤（NENs）的准确诊断具有挑战性，尤其是在低分化神经内分泌癌（NECs）中。本研究旨在通过真实世界数据和机器学习算法分析，寻找NENs诊断工作中最佳或最佳组合的神经内分泌标志物。方法：检索了进行四种神经内分泌标志物（嗜铬粒蛋白、突触素、CD56和INSM1）检测的细胞学病例。计算每种标志物单独或组合使用的敏感性、特异性及受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC-ROC）。同时测试了两种机器学习算法，即神经网络和随机森林。结果：研究队列包括106例NENs（64例NECs和42例高分化神经内分泌肿瘤 [NETs]）及36例非NEN病例。突触素和INSM1的组合敏感性为0.95，特异性为0.92，AUC-ROC为0.93。将CD56加入该组合后，在所有NENs及NEC病例中，敏感性和AUC-ROC分别进一步提高至1和0.96。此外，在NETs中，嗜铬粒蛋白、突触素和INSM1的组合敏感性为1，特异性为0.92，AUC-ROC为0.96。机器学习模型，特别是随机森林和神经网络，证实了突触素、INSM1和CD56联合使用的有效性。结论：突触素、INSM1和CD56的组合在所有NENs的诊断工作中表现最佳，尽管对于NETs可能选择嗜铬粒蛋白。随机森林和神经网络模型支持常见实践规则，即至少需要三个标志物中的两个呈阳性，以实现最佳标志物利用。
